content: It’s hard to explain but it’s a mix from I would not recommend someone to get it in terms of future proof, but also yes it’s the perfect device for a lot of people to play a ton games; I don’t regret getting one but also it’s so expensive and I think about it often. Maybe in several months if PC parts become cheaper I might feel more remorse, if parts become more expensive might pass. I don’t think it’s about the device itself but the idea of the specs/price in a small pocket of timing.
